# Fetch all liked songs (paginate)
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page or (isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page):
        print("Error or empty:", page)
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Total liked songs:", len(liked_songs))
print("Liked song IDs:", [s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs])
